Description & Layout Hierarchy: A single SVG asset built from N parallel strand-paths, each sharing one ordered point-set across two named states (coiled/assembled vs. straight/exploded); a shared progress value (0 to 1) is lerped per-point and redrawn every frame, so the asset visibly reconfigures between states rather than cross-fading between two images.
Background Elements: Sits inside a bordered rounded card on the page's own base surface; an optional soft radial glow, color-matched to the asset, sits behind it at low opacity.
Typography & Spacing Specs: Asset fills a fixed-aspect stage with no intrinsic text; step labels or a state caption sit below in the project's mono/label face, 11 to 13px, uppercase, wide tracking.
Motion & Animation Mechanics: One motion value drives every strand via per-frame recomputation, never a CSS cross-fade between pre-rendered states: ambient looping (0 to 1 to 0 with pauses) for atmosphere, spring-to-step-target for an interactive walkthrough, or held static per variant with a separate shimmer-sweep on swap.
Helpful Tags & Comments: path-morph-rig, dual-state-svg, progress-driven, transformation-story, step-walkthrough-stage -- reuse across a hero (ambient), a walkthrough (interaction-triggered) and a variant picker (static) on one page without it reading as a repeated signature move, since each use has a different trigger and narrative job; only reach for it when the product has a literal two-state physical story.
Sample Sections / Use Cases: Convertible or modular hardware heroes, before/after physical-product transformations, wearable-to-tool product demos, assembly or disassembly instructions, packable/foldable gear showcases.
